$comment: Sanitization gate config for hermes-agent-mt. The gate itself lives in cyborg-garden/swarm-map (docs/sanitization-gate.md); this file only says what a particular means here.
package_kind: public multi-tenant fork of hermes-agent; the fork's own layer ships to every agent in every deployment that builds from it
$comment_prefixes: Fork-only paths. Upstream content is out of scope for the semantic layer; it is upstream's published work. Top-level *.md are always included.

semantic.domain_noun: downstream deployment, operator instance, customer or investigation
flag_examples: names of real individuals tied to one deployment (operators, customers, end users, subjects)
operator- or instance-specific infrastructure: hostnames, chat or group IDs, server addresses, account numbers, phone numbers
a codename or label that identifies one deployment, customer or case
credentials, tokens, internal hostnames, server addresses or chat/group IDs of a real deployment
do_not_flag_examples: the publishing organisation and its public projects: Cyborg Garden / cyborg-garden / cyborg.garden, the former names NimbleCo / NimbleCoAI / NimbleCoOrg / nimbleco.ai, this repo's own name and GitHub URLs
Hermes, hermes-agent, Nous Research and upstream's published contributors, docs and identifiers
Swarm Map / swarm-map, the former names Hermes Swarm Map / HSM, and the fork's own architecture and design notes
generic tool, API, library, model, provider and standard names, and public reference material

deterministic.$comment_allow: Exact values only (the gate matches the whole detected value, never a substring). Each one cannot be anyone's real data. Loopback/unspecified/cloud-metadata addresses: 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0, 169.254.169.254. Package version strings that look like dotted quads (pyproject.toml, uv.lock): 1.2.1.0 ... 13.1.1.3. i@izs.me: the glob maintainer's address inside npm's published deprecation notice in pnpm-lock.yaml, upstream package metadata, not a contributor. NANP 555 fiction numbers in agent/moa_loop.py docs: (555) 123-4567, 555-123-4567, 555.123.4567, +1 555-123-4567, +14155551234. +10000000000 / +10000000001: invalid NANP (area code cannot start with 0) used as test fixtures. http://user:pass@host``: a docstring placeholder in gateway/platforms/base.py. ipv4_scope stays 'all' and allow_fiction_phones stays off on purpose: both would excuse whole classes (private LAN addresses, every 555 number). No IPv6 entry (::1): the gate has no IPv6 detector.
